#### `stc.relics.boot.enable`

Whether to enable systemd-boot + EFI bootloader configuration.

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `false`
- **Example:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/boot.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/boot.nix)
